## CreateApiKeyOptions.knownPermissions property

The permissions the target app(s) define, when the caller knows them (for example from a manifest). Used only to reject a requested permission that differs from a known one in letter case alone, and to name the closest valid permissions when a requested one is malformed. Permissions that match nothing known are still accepted, since later app versions may add routes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
knownPermissions?: readonly string[] | undefined;
```
